"title": "Open New Client Account",
"text": "Start intake for a new joint taxable account for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern, to be funded from excess cash reserves at Velvet Acorn Custody, and collect ownership and risk‑profile details before preparing paperwork.",

"text": "Collect required registration type, ownership details, beneficiary or authorized-party information if applicable, tax identification documentation status, risk profile, and intended funding source using firm-approved intake materials.",

"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": null
},
{
"title": "Prepare and review application package",
"text": "Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement updates, fee schedule, disclosure delivery record, and any transfer or funding paperwork. Check for missing signatures, inconsistent names, and incomplete suitability information.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "7b1c238f-c077-58f3-abf7-cfef829c2abc"
},
{
"title": "Coordinate signatures and submission",
"text": "Send the application package through the approved signature process, track completion, and submit to the custodian or operations platform after verifying all required fields are complete.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": null
},
{
"title": "Confirm account setup and funding readiness",
"text": "Verify that the account is established, document the account title and registration, confirm funding or transfer instructions are ready, and notify the advisor that the account is available for investment review.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": null
}
],
"evidence": "They agreed by 2025-08-05 to start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve, with ownership and risk profile information to be collected before paperwork is prepared."
},
{
"templateId": "652157be-e8e6-5f89-b001-6e15103f7c88",
"title": "Collect Benefits Enrollment Information",
"text": "Collect the required benefit enrollment information for Nora Thimblefern.\n\nComplete the following placeholders before reviewing benefit enrollment choices:\n\nEmployee or participant name: Nora Thimblefern\nEmployer or plan sponsor: Amber Teapot Systems\nEnrollment event type: QUALIFYING LIFE EVENT\nCoverage effective period: [RELATIVE OR PLAN YEAR PERIOD]\nAvailable medical options: [PLAN OPTIONS]\nAvailable dental and vision options: [PLAN OPTIONS]\nHealth savings or flexible spending account eligibility: [HSA / FSA DETAILS]\nEmployer retirement plan election status: 401(k)\nCurrent contribution percentage or amount: [CURRENT ELECTION]\nProposed contribution percentage or amount: [PROPOSED ELECTION]\nEmployer match formula: [MATCH DETAILS]\nBeneficiary update needed: [YES / NO / UNKNOWN]\nDocuments to request: [BENEFITS GUIDE, RATE SHEET, PLAN SUMMARY, BENEFICIARY FORM, OTHER]\nQuestions for advisor review: [OPEN QUESTIONS]\n\nSubmit the completed information by 2025-08-09 to ensure the qualifying marriage event is processed.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Employer benefit elections remain needed by 2025-08-09 because Nora reported the marriage is a qualifying event and the couple has not decided whether Caleb should move to Nora’s medical plan or keep separate coverage."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Document Household Intentions and Update Beneficiaries",
"text": "Document the current household intentions for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern, and update beneficiary and transfer‑on‑death designations on Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-08-15",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "They agreed by 2025-08-15 to document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms, after a review found Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Obtain and Upload Marriage Certificate",
"text": "Obtain the marriage certificate for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern and upload it to the secure portal so the custodian can update name and household registration.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-08-01",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Proof of marriage remains needed by 2025-08-01 because the custodian requires it for certain name and household registration updates, and Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Refresh Monthly Cash Flow Worksheet",
"text": "Refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern using their combined income, mortgage payment, student loan payment, and the six‑month cash reserve target.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-08-20",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "They agreed by 2025-08-20 to refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet using combined pay and the reserve target because Caleb’s student loan payment and the townhouse mortgage will now be considered in one household plan."
}
]
